Title: Invented Rule-Pack Example Notice

It is not an engineering design basis, not a standards interpretation, not a project specification, and not suitable for professional reliance.  The example uses original invented values and labels to demonstrate the OpenPipeStress rule-pack schema surface. It must not be used as a source of engineering criteria, material properties, stress limits, allowables, SIF/flexibility data, dimensional tables, owner requirements, vendor data, or code compliance decisions.  Any real rule pack must be supplied by a responsible user or organization, reviewed for provenance and redistribution rights, kept private where required, and evaluated by competent human engineering judgment before use on a real project.  The software may report user-rule checked, user-rule failed, missing-input, or human-review-required states. It does not certify, approve, seal, authenticate, or declare engineering code compliance for reliance.
